name: Avant USD
oneLiner: avUSD is Avant's centralized dollar stablecoin, redeemable 1:1 for USDC and deployed into actively managed market-neutral strategies for yield.
collateral: avUSD is fully backed 1:1 by USDC and is the non-yield-bearing, 1:1-redeemable receipt for deposited USDC. The actively managed market-neutral strategies (basis trades, lending-rate arbitrage, yield trading, lending markets, liquidity provisioning, and private liquidity deals) generate yield that accrues to the staked savUSD senior tranche, with the avUSDx junior tranche and a dedicated avUSD Reserve Fund absorbing strategy losses ahead of savUSD; avUSD holders themselves receive no yield
pegMechanism: 1:1 redemption for USDC via Avant Protocol with a 0.05% redemption fee and 1–7 day settlement window; avUSD itself receives no yield, while staking into the separate savUSD token is the yield-bearing route

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Avant identifies Avalanche as the native avUSD minting chain and says in-app bridging across supported networks uses Chainlink CCIP and LayerZero. Because the route depends on external messaging/validation networks rather than only issuer-native settlement, it is reviewed as an external validated-network route.

applicabilityBasis.summary: avUSD is the non-yield Avant base token backed 1:1 by USDC and redeemable through protocol mint/redeem flows.

genius.notes: avUSD has stablecoin-like reserve and redemption disclosures; no public GENIUS approval or foreign-issuer exception source was found. Terms of Use (avantprotocol.com) govern under BVI law and refer to 'Avant Protocol Foundation and its affiliates' as the operating entity; company profiles list Palo Alto, CA as operational HQ but no US legal entity name is disclosed. BVI domicile retained as primary; issuerPathway kept unknown pending clearer entity structure disclosure.

reserves.name: USDC (1:1 backing, deployed into delta-neutral strategies via 0xPartners)

mintAuthority.summary: avUSD is minted 1:1 against USDC deposited into Avant's AvantMintingV2 contract on Avalanche; the minting contract and all avUSD token instances share a single Ownable owner EOA (Avant MPC-custodied Fireblocks/Fordefi key), with an issuer-backend policy engine gating access.

controls.label: Avant avUSD AvantMintingV2 contract
controls.evidence: At Avalanche block 87747021, eth_getCode returned contract bytecode (len=29534). owner() returned 0xd4d23209aae8630bf386b7393763a5b7865e57cb. EIP-1967 proxy slots both zero (not a proxy). No AccessControl enumeration interface; uses simple Ownable pattern.

controls.label: Avant avUSD owner EOA (MPC/Fireblocks)
controls.evidence: At Avalanche block 87747021, eth_getCode returned empty bytecode (EOA confirmed). owner() on AvantMintingV2, avUSD token (Avalanche, Ethereum, Linea) all returned this same address. Avant docs describe Fireblocks/Fordefi MPC custody for privileged operations.

controls.label: Avant Protocol operations backend (MPC + policy engine)
controls.evidence: Avant docs describe MPC wallets (Fireblocks/Fordefi), a transaction policy engine, RBAC, and address whitelisting gating minting. The confirmed on-chain EOA owner is the MPC-controlled address.

review.evidence: At Avalanche block 87747021: AvantMintingV2 (0xcb43139E...) owner() = 0xd4d23209aae8630bf386b7393763a5b7865e57cb; avUSD token (0x24de8771...) owner() = same EOA; Ethereum avUSD (0xf4c13d63...) owner() = same EOA; Linea avUSD (0x37c44fc0...) owner() = same EOA. eth_getCode on EOA returned empty (confirmed EOA). EIP-1967 proxy slots zero on all contracts. No AccessControl; Ownable pattern confirmed. Issuer-backend MPC layer corroborated by Avant docs.
